# Rice & Spice

> Sushi Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Super fresh rolls, Laos ceviche and Tipsy Noodle, with Thai and Chinese dishes too.

- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Sushi rolls; Sashimi and nigiri; Noodles and rice
